user.title: Home Signals
user.description: Pick the entities the activity feed should watch, then tell Needs you where to look. Every Needs you field is optional — leave one empty and that check simply contributes nothing.

data.done_lists: To-do lists that keep a "done today" record
data.people: People worth a row when nobody can locate them
data.ignore_unavailable: Never report these (offline or low battery)
data.salt_both_threshold: Alert when every side is at or below (%)
data.salt_one_threshold: Alert when any one side is at or below (%)
data.security_locks: Locks that must be locked (empty means all)
data.security_openings: Door and window contacts that must be closed

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

dismiss.name: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Clear one Needs you row for good.

item_id.name: Item

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Hide one Needs you row for a while.

hours.name: Hours

reset.name: Reset dismissals

save_recipe.name: Save recipe
save_recipe.description: Create a recipe in Mealie, or change one.

recipe.name: Recipe
recipe.description: The slug or id of the recipe to change. Omit to create one.

description.name: Description
description.description: A line or two about it.

total_time.name: Total time
total_time.description: How long it takes, in words.

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: One per line. Replaces the whole list.

method.name: Method
method.description: One step per line. Replaces the whole method.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Tag names, replacing the recipe's tags. Missing tags are created.

favourite.name: Favourite
favourite.description: Whether it is a favourite of the Mealie user whose token this is.

prep.name: Prep and cook
prep.description: Split the method into prep ahead and to cook: {mode: split, steps: [timing of each prep step]} with the prep steps first in the method; {mode: none} for a recipe with nothing to do ahead; {mode: order} to take a split off. An unchecked split may carry original, the method's lines as they were, kept until it is checked.

save_photo.name: Save photo
save_photo.description: Keep a photo sent by a card where an AI task can see it.

image.name: Photo
image.description: A JPEG, PNG or WebP as base64, or as a data URL. Under 3 MB.

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: Where under local media/home_signals to keep it.

save_prep_session.name: Save prep session
save_prep_session.description: Plan one sitting of meal prep: when it has to be done by, and which meals' ahead-of-time steps it covers. Kept as one Home Tasks item with that deadline, created or updated. Give no items to remove the session.

id.name: Session
id.description: The session to change. Leave out to start a new one.

due.name: Due
due.description: When the prep has to be done by.

items.name: Meals
items.description: One per meal: date, entry_type, name, and optionally recipe_id, slug, steps (the prep steps as text) and minutes.

title.name: Title
title.description: The task's name. Defaults to "Prep:" and the meals.

remove_prep_session.name: Remove prep session
remove_prep_session.description: Forget a prep session and remove its Home Tasks item.

prep_done.name: Prep done
prep_done.description: Tick a prep session's Home Tasks item.

prep_settings.name: Prep settings
prep_settings.description: When meals are eaten, when prep usually happens, and which list holds it.
